label: a_sch_cafe01_eve03
text: When Rotom enters a microwave, it turns into\nHeat Rotom! I heard it even changes type!

label: a_sch_cafe01_eve05
text: I’ve been told there are Pokémon that\ncamouflage themselves as fruit...

label: a_sch_cafe01_eve06
text: I’m gonna have a good meal and get some Meal\nPowers! Maybe that’ll help my grades!

label: a_sch_cafe01_eve07
text: I haven’t even had firsts and I already want\nseconds!

label: a_sch_cafe01_eve13
text: Sandwiches you make together taste even better\nwhen you eat them together!

label: a_sch_cafe01_eve14
text: Fruit makes a delicious addition to sandwiches,\nyou know!

label: a_sch_cafe01_eve19
text: I heard that in other regions, people like to eat\nrice covered in this stuff called curry...\c\nHave you ever had curry before?

label: a_sch_cafe01_en01
text: I didn’t think it’d be so warm right next to a\nrefrigerator...

label: a_sch_cafe01_en09
text: Teatime with my Pokémon... Such an elegant way\nto pass the hours!

label: a_sch_cafe01_en10
text: It’s quite chic to have teatime at night, don’t\nyou think?
